task_definition.task_description: Please check the bedroom thermostat and its current status, then look up the bedroom access/lock status and save a note about that before making any HVAC changes. After that, set the bedroom thermostat to 22°C in eco mode, convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, and analyze the note: “Bedroom thermostat adjusted after confirming area access status.”

user_input.query: For user_id u_alice, please check the bedroom thermostat on channel app for device_id ac_bedroom and tell me its current status. Then look up the bedroom access/lock status and save a note titled "Bedroom lock status before HVAC change" about that before making any HVAC changes, with priority medium. After that, set the bedroom thermostat to 22°C in eco mode, convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, and analyze this note: "Bedroom thermostat adjusted after confirming area access status."

user_input.operation_note: Bedroom thermostat adjusted after confirming area access status.
